name: HQminiMap
summary: High-res map and live data of your game, in the free HQminiMap desktop app
description:
Exports the map, scans it from above and streams your live game data to the free HQminiMap desktop app, which builds a high-resolution orthophoto and an interactive live map.
Get the app: https://github.com/Spit8/HQminiMap/releases/latest
